entities.name: Amazon S3 (Raw)
entities.rationale: S3 bucket for raw trade data uploads, located at the top-left inside the 'Data Ingestion' container.

entities.name: AWS Lambda (Validation)
entities.rationale: Lambda function triggered to validate incoming raw data, located at the top-middle inside the 'Data Ingestion' container.

entities.name: Amazon S3 (Validated)
entities.rationale: S3 bucket storing validated trade data, located at the top-right inside the 'Data Ingestion' container (AWS_Icon_6).

entities.name: AWS Lambda (Processing)
entities.rationale: Lambda function processing validated data and ingesting into OpenSearch, located at the bottom-right inside the 'Data Ingestion' container (AWS_Icon_5).

entities.name: AWS OpenSearch (Ingestion)
entities.rationale: OpenSearch cluster running on Graviton2 instances for indexing trade data, located at the bottom-middle inside the 'Data Ingestion' container.

entities.name: User
entities.rationale: End users accessing reports and data via web or mobile clients, located on the left side outside the containers.

entities.name: Front End (FE)
entities.rationale: Angular web frontend application drawn as a hand-drawn box labeled 'FE' inside the 'Data Retrieval' container.

entities.name: Back End (BE)
entities.rationale: Python backend application drawn as a hand-drawn box labeled 'BE' inside the 'Data Retrieval' container.

entities.name: AWS OpenSearch (Retrieval)
entities.rationale: OpenSearch cluster queried during data retrieval, located in the middle row inside the 'Data Retrieval' container (AWS_Icon_4).

entities.name: Amazon S3 (Reports)
entities.rationale: S3 bucket storing large exported reports for pre-signed URL downloads, located in the middle row inside the 'Data Retrieval' container (AWS_Icon_3).

entities.name: Amazon RDS
entities.rationale: Relational database service queried by the backend application, located at the bottom-middle inside the 'Data Retrieval' container (AWS_Icon_2).

entities.name: Amazon SES
entities.rationale: Simple Email Service used to send download links and notifications to users, located at the bottom-right inside the 'Data Retrieval' container (AWS_Icon_1).

visual_connections.description: Raw data upload triggers the validation Lambda function.
Validation Lambda saves validated data into S3.
Validated S3 bucket triggers the data processing Lambda function.
Processing Lambda ingests indexed data into the OpenSearch cluster.
User interacts with the Angular web application front end (labeled 'Web').
Front end returns responses back to the user browser.
User requests are routed to the Python backend application (labeled 'Mobile').
Backend returns processed data and query responses to the user.
Backend queries the OpenSearch cluster for fast data retrieval.
Backend queries the Amazon RDS database for report data.
